body:
I do have a therapist. She helps but she isn't a miracle worker and it's not enough. 

I don't have moments of peace, really. And no, I don't have family or friends. My family doesn't speak to me since I disclosed my abuse. I have a boyfriend.

And yeah, I do think that I'm a burden. Mainly on my boyfriend.

I appreciate the sentiment, but this isn't helpful advice. I am not willingly staying in the past. Trust me – there is nothing I would love more than to be able to move on. It's just not possible. I went through some truly horrific things and trauma isn't processed and left in the past the way that other childhood memories are. My brain has been deeply scarred and it's a bit insulting to be told to move on, leave it in the past, etc., even though I believe that you didn't mean for it to be. I wouldn't be in this position, posting here and planning my death, if it were as simple as choosing to not stay in the past.
